_about: Escape-authored journal prompts, keyed by mode then Mood Orb tone. Served free (no LLM call). '{word}' is replaced with the user's mood word. Lucille-guided mode may optionally personalise one of these with the LLM, but the dataset is always the fallback.

bright: You're feeling {word}. What's fuelling it, and how do you want to spend it?
Capture this — what would you want to remember about today?
What went right that you didn't expect?
calm: A blank page, but I'm here. What's alive for you right now?
Things feel {word}. What made room for that today?
Write whatever is drifting through, no need to make it neat.
tender: Something feels {word}. Who or what is close to your heart right now?
What do you want to hold onto from today?
Write a few lines to the part of you that's feeling soft.
restless: You came in {word}. What's the loudest thing in your head?
Empty the tabs: list everything pulling at you, then circle one.
Where in your body is the restlessness sitting?
heavy: It's okay to feel {word}. What's weighing the most right now?
Write it plainly — no fixing yet, just naming.
What would a kind friend say if they read this page?
mixed: A blank page, but I'm here. What's alive for you right now?
If today had a weather report, what would it say?
What's one thing you noticed about yourself today?

guided.label: Lucille guided
guided.sub: She asks, you answer, she reflects

bright: You're {word}. What made today work, and how could you make room for more of it?
Name one strength you used today. Where else could it help you?
calm: You came in {word}. What helped you get here, so you can find it again?
What does your body feel like when it's this settled?
tender: You feel {word}. What's asking to be acknowledged?
Who would you thank today if you could, and for what?
restless: You came in {word}. What's the loudest thing in your head this evening?
What's one thing you can let wait until tomorrow?
heavy: You're carrying something {word}. What happened, in a sentence or two?
What's one small thing that would make the next hour a little lighter?
mixed: Your mood is {word}. What's pulling you in two directions?
What's one thing you need more of this week?

bright: Three things that went right today — however tiny.
calm: Three small things that brought you ease today.
tender: Three people or moments you're grateful for right now.
restless: Even on a {word} day: three small things that went right.
heavy: On a {word} day, gratitude can be tiny. Name three things that helped, even a little.
mixed: Three small things that went right today — however tiny.

bright: Set one intention to carry this energy into tomorrow.
calm: Set one intention to protect this calm tonight.
tender: Set one gentle intention for the people (or the you) you care about.
restless: Set one intention for tonight. A single line is enough.
heavy: One small, kind intention for tonight. Keep it tiny.
mixed: Set one intention for tonight. A single line is enough.

prompts: What do you want to remember? What are you hoping for?
Dear future me — here's what today felt like…
